reference.name: Locker Sweep (keywords)
reference.text:
Problem: Locker Sweep
START
INPUT n
INPUT bankName
IF n < 1
    THROW "n must be at least 1"
END IF
SET openCount TO 0
FOR i = 1 TO n
    IF i is a multiple of 3
        CONTINUE
    END IF
    FLIP the state of locker i
    IF locker i is now open
        SET openCount TO openCount + 1
    ELSE
        SET openCount TO openCount - 1
    END IF
END FOR
SWITCH the state of locker 7
    CASE open
        SET verdict TO "open"
    CASE closed
        SET verdict TO "closed"
    CASE never touched
        SET verdict TO "never touched"
END SWITCH
PRINT bankName
PRINT verdict
PRINT openCount
END

reference.name: Word Audit
reference.text:
Problem: Word Audit
START
INPUT word
IF word is an empty string
    THROW "nothing to audit"
END IF
SET vowels TO 0
SET digits TO 0
SET others TO 0
FOR EACH character IN word
    IF character is a space
        CONTINUE
    END IF
    SWITCH the kind of character
        CASE vowel
            SET vowels TO vowels + 1
        CASE digit
            SET digits TO digits + 1
        CASE anything else
            SET others TO others + 1
    END SWITCH
END FOR
PRINT word
PRINT vowels
PRINT digits
PRINT others
END

reference.name: Savings Run
reference.text:
Problem: Savings Run
START
INPUT deposit
INPUT target
INPUT weeks
IF target < 0
    THROW "target cannot be negative"
END IF
SET balance TO 0
SET hitWeek TO 0
FOR week = 1 TO weeks
    IF week is a multiple of 4
        CONTINUE
    END IF
    SET balance TO balance + deposit
    IF balance >= target
        SET hitWeek TO week
        BREAK
    END IF
END FOR
SWITCH
    CASE hitWeek is 0
        SET result TO "missed the target"
    CASE hitWeek is weeks
        SET result TO "hit on the last week"
    CASE hitWeek is less than weeks
        SET result TO "hit early"
END SWITCH
PRINT result
PRINT balance
END

reference.name: Coin Drawer
reference.text:
Problem: Coin Drawer
START
INPUT amount
INPUT the supply of quarters, dimes, nickels and pennies
IF amount < 0
    THROW "amount cannot be negative"
END IF
SET the count of each coin TO 0
WHILE amount > 0
    IF the drawer has no coins left
        BREAK
    END IF
    SET coin TO the largest coin that is no more than amount and still in the drawer
    SWITCH coin
        CASE quarter
            PRINT "quarter"
        CASE dime
            PRINT "dime"
        CASE nickel
            PRINT "nickel"
        CASE penny
            PRINT "penny"
    END SWITCH
    SUBTRACT the value of coin FROM amount
    ADD 1 TO the count of coin
    TAKE one coin out of the drawer
END WHILE
PRINT the count of quarters
PRINT the count of dimes
PRINT the count of nickels
PRINT the count of pennies
END

reference.name: Locker Sweep, plain words, chain of IFs
reference.text:
Locker Sweep
get n, the number of lockers, and the name of the bank
if n is less than 1
    stop with an error saying n is bad
all lockers start closed, and the open count starts at 0
repeat for every locker number from 1 up to n
    if the number is a multiple of 3
        skip this locker and go on to the next one
    flip the locker (closed becomes open, open becomes closed)
    if it is open now, add 1 to the open count, otherwise take 1 off
after the walk, look at locker 7
if locker 7 is open
    the verdict is open
otherwise if locker 7 is closed
    the verdict is closed
otherwise
    the verdict is never touched
show the bank name, the verdict and the open count

reference.name: Coin Drawer, plain words, different keywords
reference.text:
Coin Drawer
read the amount and how many of each coin are in the drawer
if the amount is below zero, throw an error and stop
set all four coin counts to zero
loop while there is still money left to give
    if the drawer is completely empty, leave the loop
    pick the biggest coin that fits in what is left and is still in the drawer
    depending on which coin it is (quarter, dime, nickel or penny), say its name out loud
    take its value off the amount, add one to its count, remove it from the drawer
after the loop, show how many quarters, dimes, nickels and pennies went out

reference.name: Savings Run, chain of IFs, WHILE loop
reference.text:
Savings Run
INPUT deposit, target, weeks
IF target < 0 THEN throw an error
SET balance = 0
SET week = 0
SET hit = false
WHILE week < weeks
    SET week = week + 1
    IF week is a multiple of 4: CONTINUE
    balance = balance + deposit
    IF balance >= target
        hit = true
        BREAK
END WHILE
IF hit is false
    PRINT "missed"
ELSE IF week == weeks
    PRINT "hit on the last week"
ELSE
    PRINT "hit early"
PRINT balance
